extra_quotes: The performance of GUMPIM and baselines is evaluated with the GEM5 simulator [60] under the X86 ISA and by integrating Ramulator2 [15, 61] (based on Ramulator [52]) for DRAM modeling.
PIM unit performance is measured with real-world UPMEM DPUs [17], and the PIM task latency is inserted into the PIM-task launch point of the CPU host program to obtain the overall computing time.

The logic circuits used in the Rank Chunk List, Address Translation Module, and Re-layout Cache are synthesized through Synopsys Design Compiler with the TSMC 90nm technology library at a frequency of 2.4GHz, and the buffer array used in the Re-layout Cache is simulated with CACTI 7.0 [3].
Although the GUMPIM interface is in the critical path between the memory controller and the DRAM interface, it preserves native DRAM device timings.
Note that for each bank, the minimum page migration granularity of GUMPIM is an entire DRAM row.

To avoid the complexity of multi-level redirection or migration chains, the system enforces serialized chunk allocation by allowing a new allocation only after the Row Migration Table is fully cleared.
